## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: ...`, `fix(compile): ...`). It becomes the squash-merge subject.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass locally.
- [ ] Docs describe the new behaviour, or nothing user-visible changed.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or one agreed in an issue first.
- [ ] Project folders still hold only user files, and agent changes still reach a project only as a proposal the user reviews.
